About Me

Builder. Architect. Problem Solver.

I'm a highly accomplished Salesforce Consultant and technology leader based in Cairo, Egypt, with over 15 years of software development experience, including 7+ dedicated years on the Salesforce platform.

My career spans Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and OmniStudio — with deep expertise in Apex, Lightning Web Components, system integrations, and solution architecture. I've led teams, mentored developers, and delivered enterprise-grade solutions for clients across healthcare, real estate, automotive, logistics, retail, and non-profit sectors.

Before Salesforce, I built iOS & Android mobile apps and scalable Java/Spring Boot backends. That full-stack foundation gives me a unique perspective when designing Salesforce architectures and third-party integrations.

Self-Assessment → Action Plan

Where I'm Investing Next

Mapping my own 1–5 capability self-rating (used for talent-matrix assessments) against my 580-badge Trailhead history surfaced a clear pattern: I'm deepest in core clouds, Apex/LWC, integrations, and OmniStudio — and lightest in a few adjacent product lines that recruiters increasingly screen for. Below are the gaps, why they matter, and the exact Trailhead trail I'm running through next.

Data Cloud
Now: 2 Target: 4

Every Salesforce talent matrix I've filled out this year scores Data Cloud separately from core clouds — it's becoming table stakes for Architect-track roles and pairs directly with the Agentforce/Einstein work already on my resume.

Trail · 89 hrs · Data Cloud Consultant prep
Unlock Your Data with Data Cloud →
Revenue Cloud
Now: 2 Target: 4

I already ship CPQ/B2B Commerce work (promo engines, quoting flows) — Revenue Cloud is the natural next step to cover the full product-to-cash lifecycle for enterprise clients moving off legacy CPQ.

Trail · ~20 hrs · Revenue Cloud Consultant prep
Explore Revenue Cloud Fundamentals →
MuleSoft Integration
Now: 1 Target: 3

My integration experience is REST/SOAP/Platform Events-heavy but MuleSoft-free. Since Anypoint shows up in nearly every enterprise integration RFP, a working-level trail here closes the biggest single gap versus Integration Architect roles.

Trail · ~1 hr · APIs & application networks
Build Great APIs and Integrations with MuleSoft →
CRM Analytics / Tableau CRM
Now: 1 Target: 3

I build the reports/dashboards clients ask for in native Lightning, but I haven't touched CRM Analytics' dataflows or dashboards — worth a foundational badge given how often BI comes up alongside Data Cloud conversations.

Module · ~50 mins · Foundational
CRM Analytics Basics →
Marketing Cloud Engagement
Now: 2 Target: 3

Journey Builder, Email Studio, and Pardot are still no-exposure for me. Not a priority for Architect roles, but a quick working-level pass would round out consultant-track applications that bundle Marketing Cloud with Sales/Service Cloud.

Badge · ~20 mins · Foundational
Marketing Cloud Engagement Basics →
Agentforce (deepen)
Now: 4 Target: 5

I've already shipped a hub-and-spoke Agentforce agent (CV Review Agent project), so this is about converting hands-on delivery into recognized Agentblazer status and eventually the Agentforce Specialist certification.

Program · Agentblazer Innovator → Legend
Earn Agentblazer Status →
